instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Ali Fahim Ni'ma
subject: 04_Advanced_Software_Eng

questions.question: Which statement is a management-perspective software myth?
questions.question_ar: أي عبارة من خرافات البرمجيات بمنظور الإدارة؟
options: we already have a handbook of standards
tested code is the only deliverable
requirements never change here now too
the customer signs without reading again
options_ar: لدينا دليل معايير جاهز هنا مجدداً
الكود المختبَر هو التسليم الوحيد هنا
العميل يوقّع دون قراءة الآن هنا
options_en: we already have a handbook of standards
tested code is the only deliverable
requirements never change here now too
the customer signs without reading again
questions.explanation: Managers often believe a standards handbook is enough, which is one of the listed myths.
questions.explanation_ar: المديرون كثيراً ما يظنون دليل المعايير كافياً، وهذه إحدى الخرافات المعروفة.

questions.question: Which statement is a customer-perspective software myth?
questions.question_ar: أي عبارة من خرافات البرمجيات بمنظور العميل؟
options: every module needs a test plan here again here too here
a general statement of objectives is enough to begin
the code must be reviewed weekly now here too now
the team must hold daily meetings too now again
options_ar: كل وحدة تحتاج خطة اختبار هنا
عبارة عامة عن الأهداف تكفي للبدء
الفريق يجب أن يجتمع يومياً أيضاً
options_en: every module needs a test plan here again here too here
a general statement of objectives is enough to begin
the code must be reviewed weekly now here too now
the team must hold daily meetings too now again
questions.explanation: Customers often think a general objective statement is a sufficient starting point.
questions.explanation_ar: العملاء كثيراً ما يظنون أن عبارة أهداف عامة نقطة بداية كافية.

questions.question: Why are software myths dangerous?
options: they increase the hardware cost here too
they reduce the code size here too now here
they mislead both managers and practitioners
they slow the compiler down now again again here
options_ar: ترفع كلفة العتاد الآن هنا مجدداً
options_en: they increase the hardware cost here too
they reduce the code size here too now here
they mislead both managers and practitioners
they slow the compiler down now again again here
questions.explanation: A myth looks like a reasonable statement, so nobody challenges it until the damage is done.
questions.explanation_ar: الخرافة تبدو عبارة معقولة فلا يعترض أحد عليها حتى يقع الضرر.

questions.question: How many software myths are listed?
options: five myths now here
seven myths too too
twelve myths again
nine myths here now
options_en: five myths now here
seven myths too too
twelve myths again
nine myths here now
questions.explanation: Nine myths are grouped by management, customer and developer perspectives.
questions.explanation_ar: الفصل يذكر تسع خرافات موزعة على منظوري الإدارة والعميل والمطوّر.

questions.question: What does the first principle of the software engineering code require?
questions.question_ar: ماذا يشترط المبدأ الأول لمدونة هندسة البرمجيات؟
options: acting in the public interest
loyalty to the employer above all
maximising the project profit
finishing before the deadline
options_en: acting in the public interest
loyalty to the employer above all
maximising the project profit
finishing before the deadline
questions.explanation: The public interest outranks loyalty to the employer when safety or welfare is at risk.
questions.explanation_ar: المصلحة العامة تسبق الولاء لصاحب العمل عندما تكون السلامة أو الرفاهية في خطر.

questions.question: What is the ACM/IEEE code of ethics?
options: a cost estimation model again again too now here
a joint professional code of eight principles
a compiler standard here here too now here
a testing checklist now too now here again
options_ar: معيار مترجم هنا الآن هنا أيضاً
options_en: a cost estimation model again again too now here
a joint professional code of eight principles
a compiler standard here here too now here
a testing checklist now too now here again
questions.explanation: The two societies publish one joint code built on eight principles.
questions.explanation_ar: الجمعيتان تنشران مدونة مشتركة واحدة قائمة على ثمانية مبادئ.

questions.question: Management presses you to ship software with a known safety risk. What does the code require?
questions.question_ar: الإدارة تضغط لشحن برمجيات بخطر سلامة معروف. ماذا تشترط المدونة؟
options: ship and document later here here
delegate the signature to a colleague
refuse and report the risk too now
sign off and stay silent now again
options_en: ship and document later here here
delegate the signature to a colleague
refuse and report the risk too now
sign off and stay silent now again
questions.explanation: The engineer must refuse to approve unsafe work and escalate the risk.
questions.explanation_ar: المهندس يجب أن يرفض اعتماد عمل غير آمن ويصعّد الخطر.

questions.question: What does professional competence require of an engineer?
questions.question_ar: ماذا تتطلب الكفاءة المهنية من المهندس؟
options: accepting any task offered now here here
avoiding all documentation too now
signing every release here again
working only inside one's competence
options_en: accepting any task offered now here here
avoiding all documentation too now
signing every release here again
working only inside one's competence
questions.explanation: The code asks engineers to work within their competence and keep it current.
questions.explanation_ar: المدونة تطلب من المهندس العمل داخل كفاءته والحفاظ على تحديثها.
